1. Provided "As Is" and No Warranty

MTL Explorer is provided strictly on an "AS IS" and "AS AVAILABLE" basis.

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the authors, contributors, maintainers, and copyright holders make no warranties or conditions of any kind, whether express, implied, or statutory, including but not limited to warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, title, non-infringement, availability, reliability, security, or accuracy.

The software is not guaranteed to be:

  • error-free
  • secure
  • continuously available
  • compatible with your hardware, operating system, browser, files, sensors, or data formats
  • complete, current, or accurate in its results

2. Informational Use Only

All outputs, calculations, visualizations, statistics, analyses, maps, comparisons, and derived values generated by the software are provided for informational and convenience purposes only.

This includes, without limitation:

  • GPS positions
  • timestamps
  • distance
  • speed
  • pace
  • ascent / descent
  • elevation
  • gradients
  • energy or calorie estimates
  • route matching
  • activity classification
  • historical comparisons
  • map overlays
  • imported or converted track data

Such values may be incomplete, estimated, delayed, distorted, or incorrect.

3. Not for Safety-Critical or High-Risk Use

This software is not a certified navigation, rescue, dispatch, safety, or mission-critical system.

It must not be used as the sole basis for:

  • navigation or route-finding in hazardous environments
  • terrain, weather, avalanche, flood, traffic, or other environmental risk assessment
  • emergency response or rescue operations
  • safety-critical tracking of persons, vehicles, or assets
  • operational decisions where failure, downtime, or inaccurate output could cause injury, death, property damage, regulatory issues, or major business disruption

Real-world conditions may differ substantially from what is shown in the software.

Always verify important information independently using appropriate official, professional, or safety-grade sources.

4. Not Medical, Health, or Training Advice

This software does not provide medical, health, rehabilitation, coaching, or professional sports science advice.

Any estimated metrics relating to performance, exertion, energy expenditure, recovery, fatigue, fitness, or similar topics are approximate and may be incorrect.

Do not use this software as a substitute for qualified medical or professional advice.

5. Data Import, Export, and Integrity

The software may import, parse, convert, transform, merge, export, or display data from files and services such as GPX, FIT, TCX, sensors, maps, APIs, and other third-party or user-provided sources.

The authors make no representation that:

  • imported files will be interpreted correctly
  • metadata will be preserved
  • exports will be lossless
  • timestamps or coordinates will remain correct
  • calculations will match those of devices or third-party platforms
  • conversions will preserve all fields or semantics

Data corruption, parser differences, coordinate drift, rounding differences, timezone issues, missing metadata, duplication, truncation, and other inconsistencies can occur.

You are solely responsible for verifying important results and keeping backups of your original data.

6. Self-Hosting, Deployment, and Security Responsibility

If you run this software on your own hardware, NAS, server, VM, cloud instance, or container platform such as Docker, you are solely responsible for:

  • installation and configuration
  • updates and patching
  • backups and restore procedures
  • firewalling and reverse proxy setup
  • access control and authentication
  • encryption and secrets management
  • monitoring and operational security
  • data retention and legal compliance

The authors are not responsible for damage, outages, data exposure, security incidents, account compromise, or loss arising from self-hosting or deployment choices.

The authors are not responsible for the legality, availability, performance, licensing status, or correctness of third-party services or content.
